IS 17405 : 2020 Calculation for Design of Ropeway Installation Intended for Transportation of Passengers-Code of Practice
ICS 45.100
MED 06
1 SCOPE
1.1 This standard covers the general requirements for calculations for ropeway installation designed for transportation of passengers.
1.2 The scope encompasses design by calculation of major components to ensure conformance to the safety and other requirements stipulated in various ropeway standards listed in Annex A.
2 REFERENCES
The standards listed in Annex A contain provisions which, through reference in the text, constitute provisions of this standard. At the time of publication, the editions indicated were valid. All standards are subject to revision, and parties to agreements based on this standard are encouraged to investigate the possibility of applying the most recent editions of the standards.
